title: MR 32.2.4 Release Notes

announcements.post_subject: A new Generally Available MR Wireless firmware is now available
A new Recommended Release MR Wireless firmware is now available

MR 32.2.4 Release Notes: This page summarizes fixes and known issues for MR 32.2.4. It is intended for administrators evaluating an upgrade or troubleshooting behaviour after deployment. Affected models and versions are limited to available confirmed engineering evidence.
Article contents: MR Access Point Fixed Issue Details
MR Access Point Known Issue Details
Release summary: This release includes 29 documented fixed issues and 1 documented known issue.

  • Campus Gateway summary
